key_insight: RL-trained reasoners are local probes of a multi-basin solution manifold, so better students come from building a complementary teacher union rather than relying on a single “best” teacher.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical training recipe for distilling stronger single-model inference systems by expanding teacher coverage first and then compressing it into one student.
method: RGRPO expands teacher coverage by training successive teachers from the same initialization and steering later rounds toward uncovered examples.
TU-OPD distills from the teacher union with reliability gating, so only trustworthy teachers contribute to each example.
Consensus-Residual Decomposition keeps a winner teacher’s excess preferences over reliable peers to preserve specialist behavior during aggregation.
evidence_signal: On mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, the Qwen3-1.7B student beat the strongest individual teacher with relative gains of 2.0%, 8.3%, and 6.9%, respectively.
watch_item: The approach depends on correctly estimating per-example teacher reliability and union coverage, which may be sensitive to teacher quality and aggregation design.
paper_title: Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold
